traslado.error: We could not complete the request. You can try again.
traslado.conflicto: The case file has changed. Review the changes before continuing.
traslado.sin_permiso: Your role does not allow access to this case file. Return to your inbox.
traslado.no_encontrado: We could not find this case file. Return to your inbox.
traslado.revisar_datos: Review the information and case status before continuing.
traslado.recuperar: Recover the result of the change
traslado.fecha_invalida: Choose a valid date within the period and no later than today.
traslado.motivo_traslado: Transfer reason for the Closure Minutes
traslado.fecha_traslado: Closure date in the original team
traslado.consecuencia: We will close the original case file and create a linked referral in the destination team. You will then need to accept it to assign its new number and download the Acceptance Minutes.
traslado.falta_propuesta: A team closure proposal with the reason “Transfer” is needed. Choose that reason and propose closure in the team case file.
traslado.segunda_persona: Closure must be confirmed by a different person from the one who proposed it.
traslado.bloqueo_spm: An SPM response or a reasoned exception from Coordination is needed before closure.
traslado.sin_destinos: There is no other active team available for the transfer.
traslado.estado_invalido: The current case status does not allow a transfer.
traslado.destino_pendiente: The original case file is closed. The destination referral is awaiting acceptance and has no number yet.
traslado.aceptar_destino: Review and accept in the destination team
traslado.acta_origen: Go to the original Closure Minutes
traslado.sin_anexo: Closure was confirmed without the finalisation Annex.
traslado.ayuda_texto: The team proposes closure for transfer. Coordination confirms closure and the destination team. Family information is copied and the link to the original case is kept. The original number, consent and milestones are not inherited. Minutes are downloaded separately; downloading does not sign or register them. SPM is the Child Protection Service.
traslado.ayuda_seguimiento: Follow-up after cessation applies to Reunification once the case file is closed. Its duration and warning period come from the current rules maintained by Administration. It ends automatically when the period expires. The team can end it earlier with a reason. Coordination can reopen it with a reason; a full period starts again on the reopening date. The previous closure and history are kept.
traslado.sin_seguimiento: No follow-up after cessation has been recorded for this case file.
traslado.solo_reunificacion: You can start follow-up after cessation once the Reunification case file is closed.
traslado.reabre_coordinacion: Coordination can reopen this follow-up with a reason.
traslado.seguimiento_guardado: The follow-up change has been recorded.
traslado.fin_proximo: The follow-up period is nearing its end:
traslado.vencimiento_pendiente: The period has expired. We are confirming its automatic end.
traslado.sin_motivos: No end reasons have been published. Ask Administration to review the catalogue.
traslado.consecuencia.iniciar: The period will start on the cessation date. Once saved, you will see its expected end date.
traslado.consecuencia.terminar: Follow-up will end on the date indicated. We will keep its history and the reason. The previous case closure is preserved.
traslado.consecuencia.reabrir: A full period under the current rule will start again today. We will keep the previous end and the reopening reason.
traslado.fecha_cierre_revisar: Review the closure date: it must be on or after the current opening or reopening date.
traslado.avisos_no_disponibles: We could not read the warnings. You can continue with follow-up and refresh them later.
traslado.ver_destino: View the linked destination case file
